generationInputs.prompt: Create a professional comparison table with the title "ALIMENTARSE VS. NUTRIRSE" for a nutrition PDF. Use a minimal design with a clean white background and elegant typography (Playfair Display for titles, Lato for text). The table should have two clearly defined columns: left column titled "ALIMENTARSE" in terracotta color (#D9957E) and right column titled "NUTRIRSE" in sage green (#88A47C). Include 5 comparison points with simple, elegant line icons next to each point. The comparison points are: 1) "Acto mecánico de ingerir" vs "Proceso consciente de nutrir", 2) "Enfoque en cantidad" vs "Enfoque en calidad", 3) "Saciedad inmediata" vs "Nutrición sostenida", 4) "Responde al hambre física" vs "Responde a necesidades celulares", 5) "Orientado al presente" vs "Orientado al bienestar futuro". Each point should have a minimalist icon. The design should fit a letter-sized page (8.5x11 inches), with enough white space to feel elegant and uncluttered. Use subtle design elements like thin dividing lines in lavender blue (#B8C6D1).
